river_name: It does not have a river but it has a water body near to it known as Ramappa Lake

ghats.name: Ramappa Lake Boating Ghat
ghats.description: Scenic lake bank located 1 km from Ramappa Temple, featuring TSTDC Boating Club with speed boats and pedal boats.

significance: Constructed during the 13th-century Kakatiya Dynasty alongside the temple to provide water for temple rituals, agriculture, and local ecosystem.
safety_rules: Follow safety instructions issued by TSTDC boating operators. Wearing life jackets is mandatory during boat rides.
